scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/larasoft/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/larasoft
  set jcr:title{String} to "LaraSoft"
end
create service user internal-content with path system/larasoft

set ACL for internal-content
  allow jcr:read on /content
  allow jcr:read on /var/workflow
end
